I've sent Dana the list in our direct message. Moss's notes mention two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492** comes from Moss's Sunday prep note for Ruth, dated 5 Oct 2025. It covers the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk failing to send drivers text messages with their bay assignments. It was opened on 4 Oct 2025 and fixed the next day.
- **#4419** comes from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. It covers barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. It was passed up to second-level support for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date, so I couldn't say when the ticket was opened.

I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared team folders. Two other North notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) have no ticket numbers. The Central notes only list tickets for Marrow, so I left those out. I didn't count tickets mentioned in posts by other people or in Quarrendon's own ticket folder, since Dana asked for Moss's notes only. I also left out a separate company called Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a Pemberline customer.
